name: Ranger HDC MR EO/IR (FLIR)
description: Mid-range pan-tilt thermal and color imager for visual identification of radar-cued tracks. 360 deg slewable.

sectorDeg.source: Teledyne FLIR Ranger HDC MR datasheet (rev 08/31/21), mirror host atline.pl

elevationDeg.source: Teledyne FLIR Ranger HDC MR datasheet (rev 08/31/21), mirror host atline.pl

rangeAccuracyM.note: Planning factor: the mid-range (10 km) laser rangefinder is optional; eyesafe 1.54 µm rangefinders in this class are specified at ±2 to ±5 m, so 5 m is recorded for a unit fitted with it.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.condition: pan and tilt unit accuracy ±0.5 mrad (0.029°); the imager centroid adds nothing at this scale
azimuthAccuracyDeg.source: Teledyne FLIR Ranger HDC MR datasheet (mirror at atline.pl), pan and tilt unit accuracy ±0.5 mrad

elevationAccuracyDeg.condition: pan and tilt unit accuracy ±0.5 mrad (0.029°)
elevationAccuracyDeg.source: Teledyne FLIR Ranger HDC MR datasheet (mirror at atline.pl), pan and tilt unit accuracy ±0.5 mrad

pixelPitchUm.note: Planning factor: the HDC MR sheet gives a 1280 x 720 InSb array and no pitch. Teledyne FLIR's HD InSb cores of that generation (Neutrino SX12, 1280 x 1024) are 12 µm; recorded as 12 µm.

focalLengthMm.note: Planning factor: FLIR publishes only '>12x optical zoom' for the thermal channel. From the HDC 350 narrow field 3.0° and an assumed 12 µm × 1280 px = 15.4 mm array width: 15.4 / (2 tan 1.5°) = 293 mm, recorded as 290 mm. The HDC 550 lens option (1.9° narrow) would give about 460 mm.

detectorPixelsH.source: Teledyne FLIR Ranger HDC MR datasheet 21-0714 (mirror at atline.pl; defense.flir.com returned 403)

fovDeg.condition: HDC 350 cooled lens option, narrow field 3.0° x 1.7° ±7%; the HDC 550 option gives 1.9° x 1.08°
fovDeg.source: Teledyne FLIR Ranger HDC MR datasheet 21-0714 (mirror at atline.pl; defense.flir.com returned 403)

mrtdMk.note: Planning factor: FLIR publishes no MRTD or NETD for the HDC MR. Cooled HD MWIR cores publish NETD of 20 mK (Lynred Daphnis-HD MW), <25 mK (Teledyne FLIR Neutrino SX12) and <30 mK (DRS HexaBlu 1280-MW); the 25 mK median is used as the low-spatial-frequency MRTD.

eoBand.value: dual: HD thermal imager plus a 1920 x 1080 HD colour TV camera
eoBand.source: Teledyne FLIR Ranger HDC MR datasheet (rev 08/31/21), mirror host atline.pl
